title: Decrease Safety Margin
statement: Reducing the safety margin will allow the robot to get closer to the obstacles, potentially enabling tighter turns and smoother traversal.
mechanism: A smaller safety margin means the robot can approach the obstacles more closely, which can be beneficial for navigating tight spaces.
